message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly **47,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner in total:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French (and allied German contingents) | ~25 000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch‑Belgian‑Prussian coalition | ~22 000 |

These figures are based on the most widely cited contemporary reports and modern scholarship.  Exact numbers vary slightly between sources, but the consensus places the combined toll at around **45 – 50 thousand** casualties.
